moments.author: Vice President JD Vance
moments.quote: This midterm, no question, was a rebuke of the president…
moments.why: He’s distancing himself from Trump, blaming Iran war & inflation for GOP midterm losses—sparking major GOP debate.

moments.author: Harmeet Dhillon
moments.why: Her dramatic resignation and comment framed the DOJ civil‑rights shakeup as conceding failure—going viral among politically engaged men.

moments.author: Hunter Biden
moments.quote: WE ARE DONE WITH DONALD TRUMP.
moments.why: A blunt six‑word declaration that resonated widely among political audiences reacting to the midterms.

moments.author: Underdog NBA (Klay Thompson quoted)
moments.quote: Hopefully I can continue the same flow… beat up on old friends.
moments.why: Klay’s self‑aware trash‑talk post after hitting a buzzer‑beater against his former team went viral among NBA fans.

moments.author: Metropolitan Police (via RT repost)
moments.quote: I HAVE NOTHING FURTHER TO SAY
moments.why: Brand’s terse remark in the newly released police interview after his conviction shocked and spread fast.
